title: Preserve sub-millisecond digits when reducing temporal literals
summary: The planner retained six fractional digits in TIME and TIMESTAMP. Two timestamps one microsecond apart remained distinct after reduction to VARCHAR.

change.description: Keep representable high-precision temporal literals intact through planner constant reduction and conversion to character data.

notes: The inputs differ by one representable microsecond. String readback tests the next consumer rather than only a temporal type's declared precision.
